GAME LENGTH & CONDITIONS

MATCHDAY SETTINGS

Occasional birds and night crowd camera glints appear automatically. Practice stays free of obstacles. Marking, defenders and the pitch-invader chase are paused.

PROGRESS & ROADMAP

Personal best: —

Arcade environments are being redesigned. Torpedo Showdown resolves tied local finals with one kick per team, starting at 55 m. Friend codes allow manual remote challenges with self-reported scores. Online invitations, verified remote competitions, authentic recorded audio and full character animation are not yet ready.

LEGAL & CREDITS

Original independent Australian rules kicking game. No affiliation with any football league, club or professional player. The stadium, fictional players and game graphics in this build are original procedural artwork. Original procedural Canvas perspective renderer and original AI-generated unbranded grip artwork. No copied console game assets. No external graphics engine, third-party game images, music or audio downloads are used. Team logo rights remain the uploader's responsibility. Uploaded images are stored locally, not published or transmitted by this prototype. “Footy Flick” is a working title pending trademark clearance. This is not a commercial-release legal clearance.
